title: Tailored dissipation for directional transport in plasmonic ratchets
summary: We present a joint experimental and theoretical study of a ratchet implemented in arra ys of evanescently coupled plasmonic waveguides with tailored losses. In this setup the time-periodic dissipation is the only active mechanism and notably, we find better rectified transport and lower losses in the transmitted signal with increased local dissipation. Using Floquet theory, we uncover a driving regime that allows efficient directional tr ansport for suitable driving frequencies and loss rates, which are linked to linear qu asienergy bands with minimal losses.
